1.text: A street pup with caramel fur. Once it trusts its trainer, the tip of its tail lights a small steady flame that never burns the hand that pets it.

2.text: Guardian of the open-air markets. Embers freckle its back, and it keeps them like fleas that bite only thieves.

3.text: Legend says every caramel dog that saved a life returns as one of these. Its turquoise fire warms but never harms the innocent.

4.text: It never fully sleeps. One eye stays open over the nest, and its cry carries for kilometres.

12.text: It lives in riverside herds and lets anything ride on its back, tired trainers included.

42.text: It lives 200 years, holding the secrets of generations of trainers in memory.

120.text: It hides among fallen leaves and gives no warning before it strikes.

359.text: It moves so slowly that moss grows all over its fur.

360.text: It sleeps twenty hours a day. Its dreams change the weather around it.

361.text: It beats its wings eighty times a second and drinks nectar in mid air.

362.text: Its feathers scatter sunlight into shifting bands of colour.

363.text: The core in its chest holds a spark taken from the sun itself.

364.text: Its curls are golden. It brings luck to anyone fishing nearby.

365.text: It sways without ever stopping, and kicks in the middle of the dance.

366.text: A living gourd that plays itself. It sets the rhythm of the circle.

367.text: Every beat shakes the ground. It keeps time for the whole ceremony.

368.text: It spins on the spot, playing a samba all by itself.

369.text: It breathes out tunes that make anyone listening weep with longing.

370.text: A walking country guitar. It sings ballads out of very old tales.

371.text: A deep drum that leads the dance. Hearts start beating in time with it.

372.text: A chapbook of verse that reads itself out loud to anyone passing.

373.text: It weaves invisible lace that catches bad dreams before they land.

374.text: Its skin is covered in sharp scales. Fishermen give it a wide berth.

375.text: It swims in shoals of dozens. Together they strip a cow in minutes.

376.text: A fire snake that punishes anyone who burns the forest. Eyes like embers.

377.text: An ancestral river king. One flick of its tail empties a whole lake.

378.text: An ancient turtle. Its shell hides a forest in miniature.

379.text: Its body is a living sphere of sun. Stars go out when it appears.

380.text: Its body is a silver crescent moon. It rules the tides and dreams.

381.text: A king of Palmares reborn. A symbol of freedom across Arauna.

382.text: Queen of the sea. Offerings are carried to it every February.

383.text: A rainbow serpent. It bridges earth and sky in a band of colour.

384.text: A forest guardian's young in its first form. Only pure children see it.

385.text: A newborn trickster. Little whirlwinds spin up wherever it goes.

386.text: The first creature of Arauna. It holds the essence of the whole region.
